hub.name: FYAISA
hub.tagline: Fuck You Amazon, I'm Sideloading Anyways
hub.description: A community hub for sideloaded homebrew on Amazon's Vega OS Fire TV devices.

apps.name: TizenTube
apps.summary: Ad-free, sponsor-free YouTube for Vega OS Fire TV Sticks.
apps.description: Runs the official YouTube for TVs web app (youtube.com/tv) in a Vega WebView and injects the TizenTube userscript at document start, giving ad blocking, SponsorBlock, DeArrow, speed controls and themes on devices that cannot run the Android APK.
apps.author: TizenTube Vega contributors

install.note: Prebuilt .vpkg is published on the FYAISA releases page. If no matching build exists, the host installer builds it from apps/tizentube-vega with the Vega SDK.

notes: Contains a vendored copy of the TizenTube userscript (GPL-3.0).
Requires Developer Mode on the Fire TV; not installable from the Amazon Appstore.
